named_gap: Public API adoption: expose the adopted generic learner as the primary fit / predict / update path, with no numerical or evidence change.
freeze: Commit this migration contract before implementation, fitting, fixture baselines, or new trials. Existing artifacts may be read to pin their identities. Root review precedes the freeze commit.
scope: A package/API/IO/CLI migration. No learner recipe, loss, optimizer, controller, benchmark threshold or existing artifact format change. Historical accepted flags and unmet task outcomes are preserved; no new numerical score promotes a model.

artifact.identity: Existing saved model metadata and numerical arrays retain exact semantic fingerprints. ZIP timestamps/compression container bytes are not model identity.

public_api.no_aliases: Replaced paths and names are deleted, with no compatibility alias, selector or deprecation shim. Structured implementations remain only in owned modules for unmigrated consumers and benchmarks.
public_api.clean_import: A fresh subprocess importing glassbox resolves exactly the five exports and imports no glassbox.experimental, glassbox.belief, glassbox.fitting, glassbox.control, glassbox.io, glassbox.integrations, glassbox.workflows, glassbox.cli, glassbox.core.dynamics, glassbox.core.model or glassbox.core.identification module. Public names are unique and do not shadow submodules.

recording_io.contract: Save/load/concatenate fingerprinted generic NPZ collections preserving configuration identity, ordered state/input channel identities, sample grid, recording and segment boundaries, arrays and optional declared excitation; reject altered archives and incompatible concatenation.
recording_io.adapter: One explicit adapter from named canonical trajectories to the existing 15 observed channels: world velocity, body rates, and row-major body-to-world rotation matrix, plus recorded commands. No platform-family branch. Configuration identity is supplied by the caller; gaps/nonfinite rows split segments instead of padding.

cli.forbidden: No tuning, model-family, split-policy, optimizer, protocol or model-selector flags on these two public commands.
cli.evaluation: Read-only forecast evaluation over every complete model-history/model-horizon window within each segment, with bounded prediction batches. Validate full contract match; reject previously fitted recording IDs or content. Report pooled and per-recording per-channel/per-horizon RMSE, hold-current RMSE and envelope coverage; no new acceptance threshold.
cli.structured_benchmarks: record_results corpus chains call owned structured fitting/evaluation functions directly, preserving their previous options and results rather than routing through the replaced public CLI.
cli.documentation: README and primary onboarding use generic fit/predict/update and generic recording IO; historical benchmark evidence remains identified as such.

fixture.source: tests/test_default_model.py:27-48; fixture construction frozen here, not dynamically selected from tests.
fixture.precision: Run baseline commit and migrated source in separate processes on the same host/interpreter/JAX/NumPy environment, with JAX x64 enabled for every fit/update/predict. Record versions. No cross-host exact-fit claim.
fixture.sequence: fit(a,b); save/load; predict original development windows; update(fresh); save/load; predict the same original development windows. Exercise scalar and batched predictions, shorter prefix, and save/load before update.
fixture.equivalence: Exact semantic fingerprints, metadata, reports, contracts, recipe, parameter/norm arrays, train/development arrays and window identities, ledger, half-widths, predictions, and updated previous_revision. The original revision stays unchanged. No wall-clock fields enter comparison.

saved_evidence.root_policy: Artifact root is a runner argument; only relative paths and their hashes below establish identity.
saved_evidence.replay: Load each pinned v3 artifact through public LearnedDynamics; require fingerprint/recipe/contract unchanged; save/load roundtrip preserves every metadata and array value; predict the frozen saved past/future command arrays and compare to stored forecasts; envelope broadcasts match stored arrays exactly. Also compare the independent NumPy recurrence. No refit of platform, control or archived synthetic models.
saved_evidence.historical_decisions: Historical full replay retains each run decision and its unmet rule flags. Use the original Linux environment for authoritative control trial sine regeneration; public model forecast replay is portable at the frozen tolerance.

tamper.rule: Alter one field without updating the archive fingerprint; public load must reject. With fingerprint recomputed, an unsupported recipe or format must still reject. Alter a pinned model, forecast, source, manifest, or saved verification summary and replay must reject even if an untrusted outer file inventory is rewritten.

qualification_compatibility.rule: Keep the old qualification plan and all 15 source hashes unchanged. Exact old hashes are always accepted. Only the three source files below may alternatively match their frozen normalized original AST after reversing the listed import-module and doc-reference relocations. Every other source still requires its original byte hash. No statement, expression, constant, default, annotation, call, identifier, alias or nonlisted string change is allowed.
qualification_compatibility.normalization: Parse AST; reverse only listed ImportFrom module/level pairs and exact listed doc-reference substrings in string constants; sort aliases by (name, asname or empty); sort only each contiguous list run of Import/ImportFrom statements by ast.dump(include_attributes=False); hash UTF-8 ast.dump(include_attributes=False). Preserve every other AST field, including docstrings. Baseline normalized digests below were calculated on source bytes matching the old plan before migration.

tests: migration source/evidence/fixture parity and tamper checks
remaining repository tests; optional simulator/integration dependencies reported separately
validation.promotion: Accept this migration only if exact same-host fixture parity, archived forecast/identity replay, artifact rejection, specified root/IO/CLI contracts, qualification source compatibility and applicable repository checks pass. Any unmet historical model-accuracy or control task remains unmet; this migration cannot claim a scientific improvement.
validation.no_repeated_tuning: Failures identify implementation regressions; do not alter frozen tolerances, fixtures, seeds, inputs or historical protocols after observing results.
